title: Apple Crisp
description: Four pounds of Granny Smith apples under a buttery oat crumble, baked until the topping is golden. Serve warm with vanilla bean ice cream.

steps.heading: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F and butter a 13x9 casserole dish.

steps.heading: Filling
steps.text: Peel and slice the apples, pour the lemon juice over them and stir. In a small bowl, combine 1 cup sugar, 3 tbsp flour and ½ tsp cinnamon. Sprinkle over the apples, toss to coat, and tip into the dish.

steps.heading: Topping
steps.text: In a large bowl, combine 1¾ cups flour, the oats, brown sugar, ¼ cup sugar, ½ tsp cinnamon and the salt, and mix with your hands. Dice the butter into small cubes, add it, and toss with your fingers until pea-sized clumps form.

steps.heading: Bake
steps.text: Spread the topping over the apples and bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until golden brown. Serve with vanilla bean ice cream.
